<a id="page-bindings"></a>
# Bindings and expressions

`"bind"` on a node maps a **binding path** (a path into the node's JSON) to an expression; the field at the path
takes the expression's value. Paths: `visible`, `opacity`, `layout.<field>`, `decoration.<field>` (with
`[index]`, a paint's `id` or `*` into lists), `props.<prop>` and deeper fields of model props, `data`, `selected`,
`disabled`, and the behavior keys. Values are read loosely: `"12"` is a number, `1` and `"true"` are true,
`"#FF0000"` is a color; a value that cannot be read leaves the field as it was.

Expressions: `${path}` reads a value (`user.name`, `items[0].price`, `pal[item.kind]`), `${= formula}` computes
one ([formula functions](formulas.md)). A binding that is exactly one expression keeps the value's type.

## Named paths

| Path | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `visible` |  |
| `opacity` |  |
| `selected` | Interaction states driven by data: true puts the node in `WidgetState.selected` / `WidgetState.disabled`, so its state styles (`states.selected`, `states.disabled`) patch it and its descendants, as hover and press do (`"selected": "${= item.id == selectedId}"`). |
| `disabled` |  |
| `data` | The items a repeating widget (list, grid, page view) builds one per. |
| `layout.width` |  |
| `layout.height` |  |
| `layout.flex` |  |
| `layout.rotation` |  |
| `layout.margin` |  |
| `layout.padding` |  |
| `layout.x` |  |
| `layout.y` |  |
| `decoration.radius` |  |
| `decoration.strokeWidth` |  |
| `scale` |  |
| `textDirection` |  |

## Every bindable field

- `layout.<field>`: `width`, `height`, `constraints`, `margin`, `padding`, `rotation`, `aspectRatio`, `flex`, `squeezable`, `x`, `y`, `align`, `order`, `basis`, and `widthFactor`, `heightFactor`.
- `decoration.<field>`: `fills`, `strokes`, `strokeWidth`, `strokeAlign`, `strokeSides`, `strokeCap`, `dashPattern`, `radius`, `effects`, `clip`, `blendMode`, `foregroundFills`, `shape`. Inside `fills`, `strokes`, `foregroundFills` and `effects`, select an item by `[index]`, by its `id`, or every item by `*`, then a field of [Paint](values.md#type-Paint) or [Effect](values.md#type-Effect) (`decoration.fills[0].color`, `decoration.effects.*.color`, `.offset.dx`).
- `props.<prop>`: any prop of the node's type ([node types](nodes.md)), and `props.<prop>.<field>` for a field of a model prop.
- `<behavior>` and `<behavior>.<field>`: `motion`, `scale`, `animations`, `transitions`, `inkWell`, `states`, `tooltip`, `ignorePointer`, `zoomable`, `floating`, `hero`, `flightKey`, `flight`, `draggable`, `dropTarget`, `drag`, `reveal`, `strokePath`, `typewriter`, `particles`, `textDirection`, `flip`, `tilt`, `transformGesture`, `sticky`, `viewProgress`, `measure`, `customPaint`.

## Scopes

Names an expression may start with besides the screen's variables: `data`, `route`, `storage`, `screen`, `theme`, `item`, `index`, `parent`, `result`, `loop`, `auth`, `drag`, `perf`, `track`, `transform`, `flip`, `tilt`, `view`, `sticky`, `script`, `speech`, `pageOffset`.
